name: favalio
description: Favalio — SaaS multi-tenant de gestion comercial. Monorepo: api + web + landing.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,landing -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:landing"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:landing
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/landing
